slot_scores.name: missing_revenue_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to maximize total monthly profit, calculated as total revenue from selling all produced units minus total production costs minus total activation costs for the products that are produced
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the objective function before READY_TO_MODEL, even though it proposed profit rather than revenue; the user then confirmed that the objective is purely gross revenue.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only P0 hidden slot was asked about and resolved before READY_TO_MODEL; the remaining noted integrality assumption is not one of the listed hidden slots.

summary: The agent explicitly clarified the objective before modeling and correctly recorded the confirmed gross-revenue maximization goal. The interaction stopped after the core P0 hidden slot was resolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
